'Unanswered >24h' = no substantive answer within 24h; holding replies ('let me check', 'Looking into this for you') do not count, and the figure includes 4 never answered at all (the whale list, the second page having no fans on 2026-08-11, the disposition of Jake's $700, and the Infloww disconnection request). 'Max team silence' = longest gap between consecutive ALTR-side messages = 2026-08-18 to 2026-08-26, 8 days, which fell entirely inside her offboarding. 'Promises' = explicit future commitments by ALTR staff; Mica's stated weekly reel-inspo cadence is scored as lapsed (3 batches in 9 weeks).
